faqSection.title: Agency FAQs
faqSection.contactLine: Still weighing it up? {email} or {call} with the founders.

faqs.question: What exactly is the whitelabel solution?
faqs.answer: You resell our platform under your own brand. Your clients see your logo, your domain and your colours across the whole dashboard, with nothing indicating that BabyLoveGrowth powers it behind the scenes.

faqs.question: What are my two options for working with you?
faqs.answer:
Whitelabel — the platform runs on your domain with your branding. Setup is free, and you pay {perWebsitePrice} per website with bulk discounts. Your clients log in to your branded dashboard.

Direct onboarding (Grow plan) — you onboard clients through our platform at {perWebsitePrice} per website with bulk discounts. You handle the CMS integrations and the content appears on your clients' sites without them needing dashboard access.

faqs.question: What does the whitelabel plan cost?
faqs.answer: Setup is free. You pay {perWebsitePrice} per website per month, the same as our standard pricing, with bulk discounts as you add websites. There are no other fees.

faqs.question: How long does setup take, and what do you need from me?
faqs.answer: You set it up yourself in a few minutes. We need a domain or subdomain you own — for example app.yourbrand.com or platform.youragency.com — the ability to change its DNS settings, and your logo and brand colours. We show you the DNS records to add, and your domain connects as soon as they resolve, usually within minutes but up to 48 hours with some providers.

faqs.question: What branding do my clients see?
faqs.answer: Your custom domain, your logo throughout the dashboard, and your brand colours and styling — from the sign-in screen to every page inside. Our branding is removed completely, so clients never see that another platform powers the solution.

faqs.question: What can my clients see and do in the dashboard?
faqs.answer: You onboard clients exactly as you would normally; the difference is that the credentials you share open a dashboard on your domain. There they review their content plan and published articles, the backlinks given and received, the technical audit and their Search Console analytics.

faqs.question: Two of my clients are in the same niche. Will they get the same articles?
faqs.answer: No. Keyword research, clustering and brand voice are set per client site, so each plan is built from that client's own niche, audience and competitors — even where the topics overlap.

faqs.question: Can each client have their own tone, audience and language?
faqs.answer: Yes, and that is the default. Tone of voice, target audience, competitors, content language and CMS credentials are configured per client site, and you switch between clients from one dashboard.

faqs.question: Which option should I choose?
faqs.answer: Choose whitelabel if client dashboard access under your brand matters to how you sell, or if owning a branded platform is part of your business model. Choose direct onboarding if you would rather manage everything yourself and your clients simply want results on their website.

faqs.question: What happens if a client leaves?
faqs.answer: Cancel that client site at any time; the rest of your roster keeps running untouched. You only pay for active client websites.

faqs.question: Do you support my clients directly?
faqs.answer: No — the platform is whitelabeled under your brand, so you keep the client relationship. We provide partner support to help you resolve anything technical.

faqs.question: Can I move from direct onboarding to whitelabel later?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can upgrade at any time, and setup is free.
